text:
maria: FWIW trying to publish the JS SDK for sampleapp and npm is blocked by a changelog merge conflict + typegen regen mismatch. anyone seen this recently?
alex: CI shows typegen checksum mismatch earlier today. build job failed before publish.
build-bot: CI: failed job #4821 - typegen-check (openapi-client). log: `Error: type hash mismatch`
maria: here's the local output when I run \`yarn typegen\`:
```
$ yarn typegen
> typegen --check
Error: hash mismatch for types/openapi.ts
Expected: a1b2c3d4
Found: d4e5f6g7
```
jordan: that usually happens when generated files drift because of nondeterministic ordering in the generator or a CHANGELOG edit that reordered headings. did someone touch CHANGELOG.md in the release branch?
sam: also double-check package.json version bump - npm will refuse identical semver. sometimes the publish job runs regenerate in a different node image so caches differ.
maria: CI shows the commit that bumped the changelog was merged after the release branch was created. local regen matches main but CI still fails.
alex: caching is suspicious. the repo cache step might restore old `types/` before regen check. short-term: run regen in CI with `--force` to avoid false negatives: `typegen --regen --force` – but agree that's a bandaid.
devex-bot: :eyes:
jordan: long-term fix: enforce deterministic output from the generator (sorted keys, stable PRNG). we have a draft PR to sort object keys at generation time, which should prevent this nondet. open a follow-up ticket.
sam: for unblock, maria can push a regen commit that updates the generated file and bumps patch semver, then rerun publish. if that passes, we merge the deterministic-gen PR later.
maria: ok pushing a quick regen + patch bump now. will include the exact `yarn typegen` run in the commit message for audit.
maria: pushed commit 9f3c2a (regen + v1.2.3 -> v1.2.4) at 1768543240
build-bot: CI: rerun job #4821 - typegen-check -> passed
build-bot: CI: publish job started
sam: if publish succeeds, please create a tech-debt card to add a pre-merge regen check and to make the generator stable. unexpected flakes like this slow down releases.
maria: agreed. reopening an issue right after this. thanks all :thumbsup:
